lines.text: Look at all the people at the Space Needle!

lines.text: It's a special night. Where's Marcus?

lines.text: His band is playing a New Year's Eve concert near here.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four, three, two, one!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Happy New Year! Wow, the fireworks are so loud!

lines.text: And beautiful! OK, what are your New Year's resolutions?

lines.text: This year, I'm going to speak English every day.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: And I'm going to learn to swim!

lines.text: Great goals! I'm going to dance every week. And you, Amy?

grammar.titleZh: 新年的说法和新年计划
grammar.bodyZh: New Year's Eve 是 12 月 31 日晚上(除夕夜),New Year's Day 是 1 月 1 日(元旦);零点大家一起倒数,喊 Happy New Year!(一般不加 a)。新年计划叫 a New Year's resolution,说计划用 be going to:This year, I'm going to speak English every day.。New Year's 里的 's 不能漏。中国的春节是 Chinese New Year(第 4 课学过)。发音:year /jɪr/ 开头是 /j/,舌面抬高,和 ear /ɪr/ 不同;Happy New Year 的重音落在 HAP- 和 YEAR 上。

examples.text: What are your New Year's resolutions?
This year, I'm going to learn to swim.
